purpose: Review candidate only; not a published bank or proof of coverage.
rules: A natural correct alternative that avoids the target is unresolved, not failed.
Prompts must not supply a conjugation model or name the grammatical rule during independent verification.
Suggested length is guidance, not a mastery threshold.
Review tasks require both drafts; the current single-response flow is insufficient.
Evaluator must judge target opportunity, correctness and discourse suitability separately.

tasks.promptFr: Raconte une sortie pendant laquelle quelque chose a interrompu ce que tu faisais. Décris la situation, puis ce qui est arrivé.
